description: This PHP source file defines the EndpointProxy class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends the Endpoint class and overrides methods related to request handling, parameter retrieval, validation, and pagination configuration for report-related API endpoints.

classes.name: EndpointProxy
classes.description: A class extending Endpoint, providing specific implementations for report API endpoints, especially handling request, parameters, validation decorators, and pagination settings.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the Request object, delegating to the parent Endpoint class.

methods.name: getRequestParams
methods.description: Retrieves request parameters, delegating to the parent Endpoint class.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Obtains the validation decorator object, delegating to the parent Endpoint class.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Configures sorting and pagination parameters using the provided filter parameters and default sort field, delegating to the parent method.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Returns rules for sorting and pagination parameters, with optional allowed sort fields and exclusion flag, delegating to the parent method.
